description: Header file defining the Request class and related performance tracking classes within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace, including request states, modes, and performance statistics for request handling.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a web request, including its state, mode, associated service, and methods to manage request lifecycle and authorization.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing performance statistics for request processing, including data collection, storage, and retrieval based on package size.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Nested class within PerformanceAdministrator, holding various performance metrics and statistical data.

classes.name: DataSet
classes.description: Structure holding individual performance timing metrics for deserialization, thread pool, execution, communication, serialization, and total time.

classes.name: Tuple
classes.description: Class for aggregating and calculating min, max, average, and count of timing data points.

classes.name: TrackingJSONRPC
classes.description: Class extending Web::JSONRPC::Body to track request timing metrics for JSON-RPC calls.

methods.name: Request::RestfulCall
methods.description: Checks if the request was received over the RESTful prefix path.

methods.name: Request::JSONRPCCall
methods.description: Checks if the request was received over the JSONRPC prefix path.

methods.name: Request::State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the request.

methods.name: Request::Service
methods.description: Returns a reference to the associated Service proxy.

methods.name: Request::Set
methods.description: Sets error code, service, and mode for the request.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::In
methods.description: Records incoming data size and updates deserialization timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Out
methods.description: Records outgoing data size and updates communication timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Acquire
methods.description: Marks the start of request processing timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Relinquish
methods.description: Finalizes timing data and stores performance metrics.
